text:
Sam: heads-up - seeing a cluster of 5xx/timeouts for hosted inference (eu-west) starting ~14:02 UTC. p95 tail spikes and lots of customer retries. filing here to coordinate. :eyes:
OpsBot: [ALERT] gateway.ingress.queue_depth > 0.9 for pool=hosted-prod-eu (14:02:15 UTC)
Priya: customer=acme-zen opened a support ticket at 14:03, they saw repeated 504s on text generation. traffic doubled for them around 14:00.
Alina: oncall - looking now. initial glance: continuous-batcher dequeue rate dropped hard, backlog growing. attaching log snippet:```WARN 14:02:19 batcher[kv-batcher-7] dequeue timeout after 120s backlog=412 active_dequeuers=2 target_dequeuers=10 kvcache_miss_rate=0.67```
Michael: kvcache miss/eviction surge matches. retention thrash after a large tenant spike. eviction throughput jumped, cache rewarm causing expensive long-seq processing -> batches slow.
Priya: customer says they didn't change anything on their side, just a sudden traffic spike from their scheduled job. They are on hosted standard tier.
Alina: repro suggestion for eng: run a short load with many long sequences to hit kv miss path:```hey-load --host https://api.redwood.example --key $TOKEN --concurrency 40 --seq-len 10240 --qps 80```
Terry: quick mitigations: (1) temporarily route acme-zen to fallback model "rwd-small-1" which is lower memory/shorter KV chain, (2) reduce per-tenant max_batch_size to 8 for 10m, (3) increase batcher workers from 4 -> 12 in eu-west. which is fastest?
Alina: (2) + (3) cheapest to try. doing a soft restart of batcher workers to pick up worker_count change.
OpsBot: deploy-bot: applying config patch to batcher pool hosted-prod-eu: {"worker_count":12,"max_batch_size":8} (rolling, 6 hosts)
SupportEng: Priya -> can we ask acme-zen to pause their scheduled job for 10m while we mitigate? They asked for ETA.
Priya: pinged customer asking for 10m hold. they replied yes, will pause.
Alina: restarted batcher group batcher-7 (rolling) - started 14:06. watching metrics. current backlog=78, dequeue_rate increasing.
Michael: observed kvcache miss_rate trending down to 0.21 after rewarm; eviction ops back to baseline.
OpsBot: deploy-bot: rolling restart batcher-7 completed (rev: 2026.03.18-rc7) :white_check_mark:
Sam: any immediate customer improvement?
Priya: acme-zen reports errors gone and p95 dropped. they saw successful calls after 14:08. sending them confirmation. :thumbsup:
Alina: leaving monitoring alarm for 30m. will follow up with postmortem anchoring on: queue_depth autoshed thresholds, per-tenant dispatch caps, and continuous-batcher scaling hysteresis.
Terry: note for tuning: consider stronger per-tenant cold-kv spinup caps + evict backoff to avoid transient rewarm storm.
Michael: also surface telemetry: kvcache_miss_rate, active_dequeuers, backlog size, and per-tenant inflight_longseq_count to console.
SupportEng: logging the customer impact and mitigation steps in the ticket. PR from Alina for runbooks?
Alina: will open a short runbook draft in eng-runbooks repo and a follow-up postmortem doc.
Sam: thanks team. converting this to an incident postmortem task. leaving thread open until 15:00 UTC to confirm stability.
Priya: customer confirmed stable at 14:20, will monitor and reopen if they see anything. closing support escalation for now. :white_check_mark:
